title: Etale Tor amplitude and bounded flat model
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, let X be a scheme, let a b : ℤ, with an explicit hypothesis hab : a ≤ b, and let K be a bounded constructible object of the derived category of sheaves of Λ-modules on the small etale site of X. Then K has Tor amplitude in [a,b] if and only if there exists a cochain complex P of such sheaves that is flat and zero outside [a,b], together with an isomorphism from K to the image of P in the derived category. The site and sheaf categories use [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and Tor amplitude is the derived-category Tor-amplitude notion in the cited declaration.
